scope.summary: Ensure every design-system panel, picker, inspector field, and visible state (component/variant editors, component-property inspector, variable/collection/mode editor, style registry, auto-layout/constraint/grid controls) is model-visible and typed-steerable through the Studio command surface (MT-007): typed command ids, auto-generated input/outputSchema, dry_run, receipts, and undo semantics for the whole design-system command family. This is the backend model-control closure over 14.10, distinct from the aggregate GUI/Argus/manual closure (MT-367).
acceptance_criteria: entire 14.10 command family model-visible + typed-steerable with dry_run/receipt/undo
expected_tests: live: every design-system command exposes typed I/O + dry_run + receipt + undo through the Studio command surface; no operator-only design-system mutation

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Design-system surface not fully model-steerable; models cannot drive components/variables/styles/layout.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
